e) Communication protocols design
f) Analog/Digital systems design 
Concerning the B2B market segment, Qualtek has been official supplier of CE sub-systems for some of the largest European CE brands.

entityDescription:
Queen Mary University of London is one of the UK's leading research-focused higher education institutions. We have over 32,000 students, over 5700 members of staff and an annual income in 2025 of 728m. Queen Mary is one of 24 leading UK universities represented by the Russell Group, that are committed to maintaining the very best research, an outstanding teaching and learning experience, excellent graduate employability and unrivalled links with business and the public sector. Queen Mary has made a strategic commitment to the highest quality of research. We have invested in this principle by systematically recruiting the best academics in their disciplines from around the world. For the quality of its research, the University is ranked 31st in the world according to the THE World University Ranking 2026, and joint 7th in the UK according to the 2021 Research Excellence Framework (REF2021).
We climbed 35 places in two years in the QS World University Rankings, and are now ranked 110 in the world for 2026 - firmly establishing our recognition as one of the top universities in the world.
Queen Mary is a top 100 global university and top 10 UK university for the second year running in the 2025-26 edition of the influential US News and World Report Best Global Universities rankings.

entityDescription:
The Romanian Space Agency (ROSA) was established in 1991 and reorganized by Govt. Decision no 923 in 1995 as an independent public institution under the authority of the Ministry of National Education. Its missions are to coordinate the national space research and applications programs, to promote space development, to be the Government representative for international space cooperation. Also ROSA is developer and integrator of its own RTD programmes by the ROSA Research Centre (RRC). ROSA, the national coordinator of space activities in Romania, is the authority designated by law to represent Romania in implementing the Accession Agreement to the ESA Convention. Also, the Romanian Space Agency is coordinating the Programme for Research-Development-Innovation on Space Technology and Advanced Research (STAR) approved by Law no. 262/2011 for the 2012-2019 period.
Furthermore, ROSA is the national representative for European Union (GNSS Supervisory Authority, GMES Committee, FP7 programme committees for Space, Security research, Aeronautics and Galileo, HSPG, Space Working party, Space Council), NATO and EDA specific issues, UN – COPUOS, COSPAR, IAF, GEO, Eurisy, ESPI and has also bilateral agreements with national agencies.

entityDescription: Solid state detectors are the future in low light sensing. The performance of SensL's solid-state Silicon Photomultiplier (SPM), and Photon Counting detectors surpasses the current standard detector - the photomultiplier tube (PMT) - and the avalanche photodiode (APD) and PIN photodiode in many applications. SensL's broad range of detector technologies in analog SPM and digital Photon Counting are designed to suit the current and emerging market for low light sensors. At the core of every SensL detector is a low light sensing silicon photodiode that is capable of converting single photons into a measurable output signal. SensL uses dedicated fabrication processes to manufacture these sensors to provide the highest degree of sensitivity and device uniformity, which is only possible with silicon CMOS processing techniques from SensL.

entityDescription: Thales SESO, 90 people, a French subsidiary of Thales located in Aix-en-Provence in France, is a worldwide leader in high precision optics for space, astronomy, lasers and X-rays. Thales SESO's history started in 1965 with the foundation of Sud Optique, bought in 1977 by BERTIN and becoming Société d'Exploitation Sud Optique (SESO) in 1979. The company then moved to Aix-en-Provence in 1980, was acquired by its management through a MBO in 1994 and renamed Societe Européenne de Systèmes Optiques (SESO). In 2011, SESO became Thales SESO after its acquisition by Thales and was managed first through Thales Optronics SA (TOSA) until 2016 and now through Thales Alenia Space (TAS) since 2016. Thales SESO is a world leader in designing and polishing large, state-of-the art high precision and low roughness optics in the meter size range. We are a recognized expert in lightening Zerodur mirrors for space telescopes. We design all the mechanical mountings and the coatings our optics, all space and/or outdoor qualified. We measure all our optics in-house with a top level metrology.
